title: perf(parser): avoid literal_eval for plain marker strings

verdicts.label: likely-bug
verdicts.rationale: The head version fails to unpickle a Marker that was pickled by the base version, raising a TypeError from the new Marker.__reduce__ implementation. The diff shows the new __reduce__ method raising TypeError when the pickled state does not match the expected '_markers' slot structure (see the added `raise TypeError(f"Cannot restore Marker from {state!r}")` and the strict `isinstance(markers, list)` check). This regression is unrelated to the parser performance change and indicates a bug introduced by the marker pickling changes.
evidence: if isinstance(slot_dict, dict) and "_markers" in slot_dict:
verdicts.facts: An object built by base from ["python_version == '3.\\n11'"], pickled, then unpickled by head fails to load: builtins.TypeError.
